11 Classes
The class framework supports twelve distinct classes. 
Reward-tier wargear complements class progression 
and the core combat rules.
This Player's Handbook supports levels 1-20. Class 
tables show the full progression, so each
class is easier to read at the table.
Unless a feature says otherwise, a class gains an Ability 
Score Improvement or Talent at levels 4, 8, 12, 16,
and 19.

11.3 Psyker
A sanctioned psychic operative walking the knife-edge between weapon and catastrophe.
Allowed Species: Human only.
Hit Die: d6.
Primary Abilities: Intelligence or Wisdom.
Saving Throws: Intelligence, Wisdom.
Armour: Light armour.
Weapons: Simple weapons, pistols, and force weapons.
Special: Uses Psychic Powers and Perils of the Warp.
classes.skills: See source training and declarative choices; no skills invented if none specified.
classes.equipment: Force sword or force staff; laspistol; heavy clothing or light armour; sanctioning brands/restraints; psychic focus; 2 Minor and 2 Standard Psychic Powers.

features.name: Warp Pressure
features.text:
A Psyker has a score called Warp Pressure.
Warp Pressure starts at 0.
Whenever you use a psychic power, increase your Warp 
Pressure by that power’s cost.
After resolving the power, roll a d20. If the result is equal 
to or lower than your current Warp Pressure,
Perils of the Warp triggers.
Example:
● Your Warp Pressure is 5.
● You cast Focused Rupture.
● Focused Rupture adds +2 Warp Pressure.
● Your Warp Pressure is now 7.
● You roll a d20.
● On a 1- 7, Perils trigger.

features.name: Psychic Ward
features.text:
When you or an ally within 30 ft takes damage, you may 
use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d8
+ your psychic ability modifier. Using this feature 
increases your Warp Pressure by 1.

frame unless they are modified for Ogryn use.

cannot be reduced again by Loyal Protector.
